name: RUNT
source:
In RUNT, players step into the shoes of Runt Strayer, the 19-year-old youngest of five brothers, the last surviving sons of a dead cult leader who once called himself the Mouth of God.

On the fifth anniversary of their father’s death, the brothers discover a horrific message written in blood across their boarded-up church pulpit: 5 Days. With the town of Skipclaw sealed behind protective walls and humanity no longer the apex predator, Runt must investigate the omen before the fifth day arrives, and choose who to accuse. Will you be able to guess right?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4141350/RUNT/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在《RUNT》中，玩家将扮演19岁青年朗特·斯特雷耶——曾自封为“神之口舌”的已故邪教教主遗留在世的五个儿子中最小的老幺。

在父亲忌日五周年当天，兄弟五人在钉死封板的教堂讲坛上发现了一行用鲜血写就的骇人讯息：“5天”。在人类早已失去顶级掠食者地位、全镇靠高墙封闭自保的跃爪镇里，朗特必须在第五天降临之前查明这桩凶兆背后的真相，并选出自己要指控的对象。你能够猜中真凶吗？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4141350/RUNT/]Steam[/url]]
